findings:
🟡 [k8-band-chip-wiring] CUT/FOLLOW-UP — mods/live/model.ts bandView (~line 685) consumes none of hygieneChip/qcChip/reviewSlot and register.ts never reads <live>/runs/<key>.qc.json, so the A1 P7b hygiene slot and P7c QC chip render nowhere at band level in this range (band.tsx is carried by no packet); excluded because the chip/publisher/pane functions are delivered and tested, the P7d Review tab IS wired via pane.tsx+register.ts, and per-field KR1 band gating is the original P7 acceptance — wire the three chips into bandView before the alpha.2 cut if A1's band table is due at 3.0.0.
🟡 [k8-devshm-portability] CUT/FOLLOW-UP — scripts/review-input.test.js watcherCtx hardcodes /dev/shm for the live dir, so the suite fails spuriously on hosts without it (e.g. macOS CI); excluded because the repo's host is Linux and the deterministic gates run there; an os.tmpdir fallback would make it portable later.
🔵 [k8-advisorymode-config-read] CUT/FOLLOW-UP — advisoryMode stats+parses ~/.autopilot/config.json on every hook fire (PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit hot path); one small synchronous read is marginal next to the transcript reads those hooks already do, so it is excluded; add an mtime-keyed cache only if hook cost ever shows in a profile.
🔵 [k8-advisory-trim-race] CUT/FOLLOW-UP — concurrent same-session hook fires can interleave the >256 KB trim (read→tmp→rename in hooks/_shared/advisory-sink.js writeAdvisory) and drop a just-appended row; excluded because advisories are best-effort telemetry (context-budget falls back to additionalContext when writeAdvisory returns false) and same-session hook fires are mostly serialized; serialize with a lockfile only if lost rows are observed.
